entities.summary: Afi Azaratu Yakubu is a veteran media personality, documentary producer and an activist. For her work with peace and sustainable development issues in Africa in general and Ghana in particular, she received the 2006 Edberg Award in Sweden and the 2013 Martin Luther King Jr. Award for Peace and Social Justice.
